headline: From Idea to Impact
subheadline: Key milestones that shaped who we are.

milestones.title: The Spark
milestones.description: Started as a weekend project to simplify Astro site scaffolding. Built the first CLI prototype in a hackathon.

milestones.title: Building Blocks
milestones.description: Developed the block system architecture. Launched the first 10 blocks with community feedback.

milestones.title: Going Edge-First
milestones.description: Integrated Cloudflare Workers for global edge deployment. Performance became our differentiator.

milestones.title: AI-Powered Scaffolding

milestones.title: Join the Journey
milestones.description: 40+ blocks, 10K+ developers, and growing. We're just getting started.
